# Pencil-out: house, duplex and fourplex at today's fees and after a cut

<!-- GENERATED by `uv run python scripts/dev/fee_pencil_out_table.py --out docs/research/fee-pencil-out.md`. Do not edit by hand. -->

For every place with coded fees (holdouts left out): the pro forma (`src/lotline/model/proforma.py`, central parameters) for a 2,150 sq ft house, a duplex and a fourplex of 1,000 sq ft units, in 2025 dollars, at the place's value of a new home (from the parcel roll where there is one: the median value per sq ft of detached homes built in the last 7 years, as the fee scenario's feasibility channel uses; else the ACS median home value, which covers older homes and so understates it) and ACS median gross rent (5-year vintage ending 2025 or earlier; also all units, so it understates a new unit's rent). Fees per unit by type from `config/fees/` under D-066 (filled where missing). **Residual land value** is what a builder can pay for the lot after value, construction, fees, interest and profit (`pencil_out.py`). **Fee share** is fees over construction + fees + interest. **Pencils** compares that with the median vacant residential lot's assessed land value plus a 10% margin, where the state has a parcel roll. The cut columns show the full fee change; how much builders keep (λ) is the fee scenario's question (D-073).
